legs.summary: Enter Caelid from the northwest at the Smoldering Church, then ride south along the highway toward Sellia and Gowry's Shack. Pick up the map and road items along the way. Note: Caelid is accessible early via a trap chest in Limgrave's Dragon-Burnt Ruins that teleports you to Sellia Crystal Tunnel — but full exploration is recommended at level 50+.

steps.text: Cross into Caelid via the northwest road from Limgrave (past the Rotview Balcony grace) or from the east Limgrave road. The Smoldering Church is in the northwest corner of Caelid proper.

steps.note: Stele on the main Caelid highway, just south of the Caelid Highway South grace.

steps.text: Speak to Sage Gowry at his shack (north of Sellia). He asks you to retrieve the broken Unalloyed Gold Needle from Commander O'Neil in the Swamp of Aeonia, in exchange for Sellia's secret (how to unlock the town).

missable.note: Millicent's full questline (Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom, Millicent's Prosthesis talisman, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Flock's Canvas Talisman) requires this first step.

legs.summary: Light Sellia's three beacon towers to lift the seal on its locked buildings, then sweep the entire town. Sellen's questline sends you to find Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway — do so now. Return the Unalloyed Gold Needle to Gowry after defeating Commander O'Neil.

steps.text: Gowry reveals Sellia's secret: climb the three towers in town and light the beacon fires at the top of each to break the magical seals blocking the northeast gateway and the sealed buildings.

steps.note: Chest in Sellia's central sealed building (requires lighting all 3 beacons).
Corpse on the rooftops near the second beacon tower.

Chest in the northwest sealed building in Sellia (requires all 3 beacons lit).

In Sellia Hideaway — where Lusat sits.

steps.text: Use the Sellian Sealbreaker key (from Sellen at Waypoint Ruins, Liurnia) to open the sealed tunnel in Sellia Hideaway. Find Primeval Sorcerer Lusat — he gives Stars of Ruin. Report back to Sellen for Starlight Shards.

missable.lockedBy: Killing Sellen or not starting her quest at Waypoint Ruins first
missable.note: Stars of Ruin is only obtainable after speaking to Sellen and obtaining the Sellian Sealbreaker. Sellen's full questline continues in Liurnia/Altus.

steps.note: Given by Primeval Sorcerer Lusat inside Sellia Hideaway — requires Sellian Sealbreaker from Sellen.
Given by Sellen at Waypoint Ruins, Liurnia — needed to reach Lusat. Obtain it before coming here.

legs.summary: Fight Commander O'Neil in the swamp's heart. Return the broken needle to Gowry, reload, collect the repaired needle, then deliver it to Millicent at the Church of the Plague northeast of Sellia. Also sweep the Gael Tunnel dungeon (south of Caelid highway) for the Moonveil katana.

steps.note: Corpse at the Heart of Aeonia grace area, near the rot flowers.
From the Erdtree Avatar boss at the Minor Erdtree in the Swamp of Aeonia area.
Also from the Erdtree Avatar at the Minor Erdtree in Aeonia Swamp.

steps.text: Commander O'Neil — in the Heart of Aeonia (center of the Scarlet Rot swamp). Summons spectral soldiers during the fight. Drops the broken Unalloyed Gold Needle.

steps.note: Dropped by Commander O'Neil — give to Gowry.
Also dropped by Commander O'Neil.

steps.text: Return the broken Unalloyed Gold Needle to Gowry at his shack. He takes it to repair. Reload the area (rest at any grace and return) — pick up the repaired needle.
Side trip: ride south to Gael Tunnel (grace at the south road of Caelid). Boss drops Moonveil and Dragon Heart.
Magma Wyrm in Gael Tunnel — drops Moonveil and a Dragon Heart.

steps.note: Dropped by Magma Wyrm in Gael Tunnel. Powerful Int/Dex katana.
Found in Gael Tunnel on a corpse in the mine — allows purchasing Somberstone [1–4] from the Twin Maiden Husks.
Corpse in Gael Tunnel main passage.

steps.text: Bring the repaired Unalloyed Gold Needle to Millicent at the Church of the Plague, northeastern Caelid (accessed by climbing the hill past Sellia's north gate). Rest at the grace and exhaust her dialogue.

steps.note: Given by Millicent after delivering the needle and exhausting dialogue at the Church of the Plague grace.
At the Church of the Plague — inside the church building.

legs.summary: Sweep the remaining western Caelid items before riding to Redmane Castle. Fort Gael holds the Flame of the Redmanes ash of war and the Katar weapon. The Caelid Wilds has several corpse pickups along the main road.

steps.text: Battlemage Hugues (field boss, eastern Dragonbarrow) drops his spirit ash — collected in the Dragonbarrow region cleanup.

legs.summary: The Radahn Festival is triggered by progressing Ranni's questline (meeting her at Ranni's Rise) OR by activating any grace in Altus Plateau. When the festival is active, enemies vanish from the castle and NPCs gather in the plaza. Alexander and Blaidd are present as optional summons. Activate the festival, speak to everyone, then proceed to the Radahn fight.

steps.text: Cross the Impassable Greatbridge to reach Redmane Castle. If the Radahn Festival is not yet active (enemies still present), fight through the castle normally. You can also enter via a side-path ladder on the western cliff to skip most enemies.

Speak to Castellan Jerren at the Redmane Castle Plaza grace. He presides over the festival. Exhaust his dialogue — this is a required step for Jerren's questline and for Sellen's questline conclusion later.
Speak to Blaidd in the Redmane Castle plaza. He can be summoned (gold sign) for the Radahn boss fight on the Wailing Dunes beach.
Speak to Alexander (Iron Fist) at the Redmane Castle plaza. He can be summoned during Radahn. After Radahn, find him at Wailing Dunes to hear his post-battle dialogue.

Starscourge Radahn — take the sending gate from the plaza to the Wailing Dunes. Multiple legendary summon signs available (Blaidd, Alexander, others). Defeating Radahn causes Nokron, Eternal City to become accessible via a star-fall crater near Fort Haight in Limgrave.

steps.note: From Radahn. Trade at Enia for Starscourge Greatsword or Lion Greatbow.

steps.text: After Radahn, Millicent moves to Gowry's Shack. Speak to her there, then obtain the Valkyrie's Prosthesis (chest in Shaded Castle, Altus Plateau) and return it to her.
